crop: Plantain (Musa AAB), French and false horn types, planted from PIF plants (stem fragment plants), successive cycles on the same mat

planting.text: 1,666 plants/ha at 3 m x 2 m recommended (1,666 to 2,500 in pure stands); holes 60 x 60 x 60 cm; 10 to 15 kg of compost or manure per hole at planting; latest planting in August (S1). PIF plants sell for 150 to 250 FCFA in Cameroon, suckers about 100 (S7).

fertility.text: Organic 10 to 15 t/ha per year; a complete fertilizer rich in N and K at about 1 kg per plant per year in 2 to 3 applications; potassium chloride 400 g per plant in 2 to 3 applications; NPK 20-10-10 at 100 g per plant 1 to 3 months after planting (S1).

care.text: Weed regularly for the first 6 months; glyphosate 4.5 L/ha against annual weeds (S1). Keep one vigorous sucker after flowering; prop from flowering; remove the male bud 7 to 10 days after the last hand (S1). Desucker every two months (S2). Banana weevil treated 2 to 4 times a year in the rainy season (S1).

cycle.text: Flowering about 10 months after planting, cycle 10 to 15 months (S2). Harvest 90 days after flowering for ripe fruit, 70 days at physiological maturity (S1). Flowering 6 to 7 months and harvest 10 to 12 months after planting under irrigation in Côte d'Ivoire (S4). Plantain clumps are usually kept three or four years (S8).

yields.text: On farms near Njombé: mean bunch 11.6 kg, mean yield 6.8 t/ha per year (1.1 to 18.8), 34% of the potential bunches harvested (S3). Bunches of 15 to 25 kg by variety, 37 to 70 t/ha at 2,500 plants under irrigation (S4). National average about 7 t/ha (S9). Batard variety trial: 29 kg bunch (S10).

prices.text: Yaoundé, June 2025: usually 3,000 to 4,000 FCFA a bunch, 13,500 on average during a shortage (S5). Medium bunch about 4,000 FCFA in 2016, up from 2,500 (S6).
